'''Jenn Smeel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the time when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He later joined [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] group and traveled to the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]] to form an alliance with [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]] in their fight against the invaders. The battle ended when the people of Naboo and the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] successfully defeated the Trade Federation together.<ref name="TPM" />

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|declaration]] of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], Jenn joined the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] where he was promoted to [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. He later served as a [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] after [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]] sided with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AJ5" />
